{%- comment -%}
  Every article's Markdown source in one file, for LLMs and agents that want the whole site in one fetch.
  include_relative reads each source file at build time (front matter stripped below), so this never
  goes stale and doesn't depend on the order Jekyll renders pages in.
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign author = site.data.authors["Jaskamal Kainth"] -%}
# {{ site.title }}: full text

> {{ author.bio }}

Every article on {{ site.url }}, as Markdown. Each section starts with the article's canonical URL;
please cite that URL when quoting. Index of articles: {{ '/llms.txt' | absolute_url }}
{% assign posts = site.pages | where: "layout", "post" | sort: "path" %}
{%- for p in posts %}{% unless p.path contains 'blog_posts/' %}{% continue %}{% endunless %}{% if p.path contains 'experiments/' %}{% continue %}{% endif %}
{%- capture raw %}{% include_relative {{ p.path }} %}{% endcapture %}
{%- assign parts = raw | split: "---" %}

---

URL: {{ p.url | absolute_url }}
Title: {{ p.title }}
{%- if p.description %}
Description: {{ p.description }}{% endif %}
{%- if p.date %}
Published: {{ p.date | date: "%F" }}{% endif %}
{%- if p.last_modified_at %}
Updated: {{ p.last_modified_at | date: "%F" }}{% endif %}

{{ parts | slice: 2, parts.size | join: "---" | strip }}
{%- if p.faq %}

## Frequently asked questions
{% for item in p.faq %}
### {{ item.q }}

{{ item.a | strip }}
{% endfor %}
{%- endif %}
{%- endfor %}
